typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsotradeservBook_outputfilename as string (),
	totblCalypsotradeservCptyProcessingOrg_outputfilename as string (),
	totblCalypsotradeservLegalEntity_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		BOOK_ID as decimal(38,0),
		BOOK_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbaBook	source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromCALYPSODBALEGALENTITY	source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		ROLE_NAME as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbalegalentityrole
fromcalypsodbaBook derive({Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		{Copy of BOOK_ID} = BOOK_ID,
		{Copy of BOOK_NAME} = BOOK_NAME) ~> DataConversion1
fromCALYPSODBALEGALENTITY derive({Copy of LONG_NAME} = LONG_NAME,
		{Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		{Copy of SHORT_NAME} = SHORT_NAME) ~> DataConversion2
fromcalypsodbalegalentityrole derive({Copy of SHORT_NAME} = SHORT_NAME,
		{Copy of ROLE_NAME} = ROLE_NAME,
		{Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		{Copy of LONG_NAME} = LONG_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		legal_entity_id as string,
		Book_id as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legal_entity_id = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		Book_id = BOOK_ID,
		BOOK_NAME = {Copy of BOOK_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsotradeservBook_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsotradeservBook
DataConversion2 sink(input(
		legal_entity_id as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legal_entity_id = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		LONG_NAME = {Copy of LONG_NAME},
		SHORT_NAME = {Copy of SHORT_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsotradeservLegalEntity_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsotradeservLegalEntity
DataConversion sink(input(
		role_name as string,
		legal_entity_id as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		role_name = {Copy of ROLE_NAME},
		legal_entity_id = LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		LONG_NAME = {Copy of LONG_NAME},
		SHORT_NAME = {Copy of SHORT_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsotradeservCptyProcessingOrg_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsotradeservCptyProcessingOrg
